title: 格雷福斯·格子围巾
description: 浓眉大胡子格雷福斯穿完整长外套，低头叠好格子围巾，霰弹枪留在安全架上。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Graves is a broad adult man with swept dark hair, a heavy moustache and beard, thick eyebrows, and a weathered but good-humored face. Preserve his rugged long coat, fur collar, gloves, opaque trousers, and heavy boots. His large distinctive double-barreled firearm rests securely on a low wall rack, pointed away and entirely inactive, with no cigar or smoke.
art_direction.scene: He sits on a station-style wooden bench and folds a thick checked scarf into a neat square on his lap. A small travel bag and a cup on a side stool give the scene an ordinary waiting-room feeling. His expression is quietly satisfied, and the stored firearm remains a subdued identity detail in the background.
art_direction.palette: warm brown, charcoal blue, scarf red, soft cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
